description: Fully recalculates dates, slack and critical path of a project with the Planitude scheduler and saves the new dates, replacing the stored ones (for an imported project this replaces the dates that came from the file). Useful after an import or a shared calendar change. Only tasks whose dates actually change are saved. Requires write permission.

projectId.description: Project id (uuid), as returned by planitude_list_projects.

name: planitude_reschedule
title: Recalculate project schedule
